thread:
olivia: quick check — planning to start the default-model unpin rollout next week. timeline and who needs to be pinged for SDK changes?

matt: thanks for the heads-up. are we doing a canary first or a staged flip per-region?

janet: prefer staged by customer tier: beta customers -> paid -> free. gives time to catch regressions.

olivia: agreed. proposed timeline: canary Mon (10%), staged rollout over 2 weeks with daily health gates. any objections?

ryan: can we confirm client fallback semantics? if client doesn't set Accept-Model, what happens after unpin?

matt: current behavior: server picks default model (will change). SDKs should set `Accept-Model` to pin. fallback is to server-chosen default.

olivia: example header we'd expect apps to add:
```
Accept-Model: redwood/gpt-medium@2024-12-01
```

janet: docs note: add snippet + migration guide. SDKs should default to pinning to the current default for one release (opt-in to unpinned later).

ryan: question on rollout comms: do we send email to integrations or just in-console banner and changelog?

matt: both. console banner + email to active API key owners 48h before major flip. include quick code sample for common languages.

sdk-bot: FYI — opened PR #312: add `accept_model` option to python/js SDKs, default preserves previous pinned version.

olivia: perfect — QA checklist for canary: sampling of generation outputs, latency and token-cost delta, and regression evals against our prompt-set.

janet: ops note: add rollout flag in Console so we can pause/rollback per-region. deploy-bot can trigger emergency rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy plan published to #eng-releases, canary scheduled 2024-05-06T09:00Z.

matt: one more: update error payload so clients can detect server-side pin change: include `x-default-model` in response headers when model differs from Accept-Model. small header, e.g. `X-Default-Model: redwood/gpt-small@2023-11-01`.

olivia: good call. janet, can you add that to API contract doc and request SDKs to surface it as `response.defaultModel`?

janet: will do. action items: 1) SDK PR merge (matt/ryan review). 2) Docs snippet + migration guide (janet). 3) Console rollout flag + email list (ops). 4) Canary evals (olivia).

ryan: tagging @integrations-team to prepare migration notes for partners.

olivia: thanks all — if nothing else, I'll start the canary Monday and post results here. :thumbsup:
